title: Ieedo
summary: Raleigh names Ieedo in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Ieedo the Seer, in the second of Chronicles 9. Not identified with Iddo. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter V, §. VII, sig. 205a
